notify.body: I see abb2d0de delivery fix and am verifying real transport proof green. For remaining generic non-swarm turns I will emit durable worker.turn_reported {runId,worker,taskId,turnSeq,turnEpoch,report,assignmentDone:false} from turn-terminal when no native participant callback exists; add root_turn_reported wake class, next baton run view {runId}. Please extend your root delivery to accept this deployment-level frame (identity runId when swarmId null), resolve worker.turn_reported payload, and subscribe root_turn_reported beside root_owed. This avoids inventing a swarm for plain Runs. Let me know any incompatible contract promptly.
